notes: Note-only, under rule 8. The copula placement in this verse has a materially different defensible reading that the accepted alignment did not name: rule 49's closing paragraph would send the construction-supplied copula to the nominal predicate פַּלְגֵי־מַיִם rather than to בְּ if that fronted nominal is read as the predicate and בְּיַד־יְהוָה as an adjunct. The reading taken is retained — the supplied *as* is the ASV's own signal that it construes the nominal as an adverbial comparison, leaving the prepositional phrase as the predicate — but the alternative is now recorded. Every source and target edge, every head and every status is identical to the accepted alignment.
